title: fatal error: tf2_geometry_msgs/tf2_geometry_msgs.h: No such file or directory in ROS 2: .h vs .hpp, the missing link and cv_bridge.h, measured
excerpt: Why tf2_geometry_msgs.h fails on Jazzy and Lyrical, why tf2_geometry_msgs.hpp fails when the target isn't linked, the KDL undefined reference, and why Humble cv_bridge has only cv_bridge.h. 14 CMake variants built on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
